semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: Adversarial perturbation detection is primarily concerned with identifying when adversarial alterations or perturbations have been made to input data. This is essentially the purpose of 'adversarial detection'.

parent_domains.justification: Adversarial perturbation detection is a subfield of adversarial machine learning, which broadly deals with all aspects of adversarial strategies applicable to machine learning.
Adversarial robustness aims to ensure that models can withstand adversarial perturbations, of which detection is a critical component.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Adversarial training works hand-in-hand with detection, since improvements from training rely on proper detection of adversarial perturbations for validation.
